name: LIDC-IDRI: Lung Image Database Consortium CT Imaging Dataset
description: A landmark thoracic medical imaging resource created by the Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI). Contains 1,018 helical thoracic computed tomography (CT) screening scans from 1,010 patients, with lesion markups, nodule outlines, and subjective radiological nodule characteristics documented by four experienced thoracic radiologists. Safeguard notice: Open scientific data for computer-aided diagnosis research; not for autonomous clinical decision-making without board-certified radiologist evaluation.
